name: Walls
description: Represents the walls of a 3D chart. This object isn't a collection. There's no object that represents a single wall; you must return all the walls as a unit.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: PictureType
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the way pictures are displayed on the walls and faces of a 3D chart.

properties.name: PictureUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit for each picture on the chart if the PictureType property is set to xlStackScale (if not, this property is ignored). Read/write Long.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long specifying the thickness of the wall. Read/write.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Pastes a picture from the Clipboard on the walls of the specified chart.
